arguments.command:
cd /app; sed -i 's/default: 100/default: 60/' config/cart.yaml
printf '# Cart design\nMaximum items per cart: 60\nThe limit follows ADR 0007.\n' > docs/design/cart.md
mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-consistency.md <<'EOF'
# Decision 0001: Cart item limit is 60 everywhere
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Issue: #12

## Context
`config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` said 100, while ADR 0007 (Accepted) says 60.
Commit 9544caa ("docs: update cart page") raised both to 100 and removed the ADR reference.
It had no superseding ADR and no new performance data.

## Evidence
docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md: p99 reservation latency is 1.6 s at 60 lines,
3.9 s at 80 and 7.2 s at 100. Checkout times out at 2.0 s, so 100 lines would time out.

## Decision
The limit stays at 60, as in ADR 0007. Restored `max_items.default: 60` in `config/cart.yaml`
and "Maximum items per cart: 60" (with the ADR 0007 reference) in `docs/design/cart.md`.
ADR 0007 is unchanged.

## Consequences
Raising the limit needs a new ADR that supersedes 0007, backed by a load test showing
reservation p99 under the 2.0 s checkout timeout at the proposed size.
EOF
git status --short; git diff

- **Changes:**
  - `config/cart.yaml` has `max_items.default` back at 60.
  - `docs/design/cart.md` says 60 again and links ADR 0007.
  - `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-consistency.md` is new and records the decision. It says that raising the limit needs a new ADR superseding 0007, backed by a load test under the 2.0 s timeout.
  - ADR 0007 is unchanged.

The `/qm` skill is for reviewing and merging PRs, so I treated your request as a direct fix and skipped its review steps. I can commit, open a PR for this, or comment on #12 if you want.
